semantic_fragments.content: Section 12.4.4 RM RESULTS TABLE for Incorrect output is marked as Pass (P). Risk Assessment Report (PT9L-FXPJ01 V1.0) covers: pressure display definition (5.2), hazard addressing (5.3), risk estimation per hazardous situation (5.4), risk evaluation (6), and risk control measure definition (7.2). Verification of risk control measure and Residual Risk Evaluation Report (PT9L-FXGB01 V1.0) covers: risk control measure implementation verification (7.3) and residual risk level evaluation (7.4). All residual risks are judged acceptable (7.5).

Sections 12.4.1 (Intentional exceeding of safety limits), 12.4.2 (Indication of parameters relevant to safety), 12.4.3 (Accidental selection of excessive output values), 12.4.5.3 (Radiotherapy equipment), 12.4.5.4 (Other ME equipment producing diagnostic or therapeutic radiation), and 12.4.6 (Diagnostic or therapeutic acoustic pressure) are all marked N/A, indicating these risk management result tables are not applicable to the device under test.
